seoTitle: How to Create Forms in Canva Using Jotform
metaDescription: Learn how to embed interactive Jotform forms into Canva designs in 2026 using the native app integration, so viewers can fill them out in place.
intro: Static Canva graphics can't collect data on their own, but the native Jotform app lets you embed a fully functional form right into your design. This guide covers connecting your Jotform account inside Canva, choosing a form to embed, and positioning it so it fits naturally into your published layout.

steps.heading: Open the Canva Apps marketplace
steps.body: In the Canva editor, open the Apps sidebar panel to browse available integrations.

steps.heading: Search for and connect Jotform
steps.body: Search for the Jotform app, initialize the connection, and log into your Jotform account to sync your existing forms.

steps.heading: Browse or choose an existing form
steps.body: Select from Jotform's template library or embed a form you've already built.

steps.heading: Position the form on your canvas
steps.body: Resize and position the form widget so it fits your design, checking that it stays responsive for mobile viewers.

steps.heading: Publish and test
steps.body: Match the form's colors to your brand, publish your Canva design as a live website or presentation, and test the form's functionality through the preview link.

faq.question: Do I need an existing Jotform account to use this integration?
faq.answer: Yes, you need a Jotform account to connect and either select an existing form or use the template library within the Canva app.

faq.question: Will submissions from the embedded form show up in Jotform Tables?
faq.answer: Yes, data collected through the embedded form syncs back to your Jotform account just like a normal form submission.

faq.question: Can I use any Canva design type for embedding a form?
faq.answer: The Jotform app works within Canva projects that support publishing as a website or presentation, where the embedded form remains interactive.

faq.question: Is the Jotform app free to use inside Canva?
faq.answer: Adding the app inside Canva is free, though your form's features still depend on your existing Jotform account plan.
